charge.summary: All four Reimu tiers playable with free practice charging; skill, opponent EX/boss and shield recovery implemented. Full parity and meter economy remain incomplete.

findings.text: SHT absolute offsets 0x2c/0x30/0x34/0x38 multiply by 10 to yield thresholds. Initial meter = first threshold. Reimu: 500/1000/1700/2500. Values are loaded from assets, not authored here.

Hold input bit 2; release selects tier. Invalid player state cancels. Charge increment is clamped speed-percent *10/100; cap is current meter; release recovery is 10 frames. Viewer practice mode now bypasses meter cap/cost and exposes all four tiers.
Basic attack also runs on higher-tier release. Reimu resets timer and invokes SHT slot 10 at times 0..20. Four records fire at time 0, damage 7, initial speed 14; no meter cost.

Table 005a0440[11] -> 0054b3e0 sets piercing byte +114. Table 005a0400[8] -> 0054b380 decelerates by 0.95 to minimum 0.2 before time 120, then accelerates by 0.2. Table 005a03d0[7] -> 0054b370 calls 0054fba0; piercing avoids hit deletion. These three entry points are absent as standalone exports.

aura.anm script29 follows player while charging; interrupts8/9/10/11 at the four thresholds; removed on release/cancel. pl00.anm script10 owns orb spin and trail; do not overwrite its rotation every frame.
Charge speed currently assumes 100 percent. Exact initialization and ability modifiers remain to trace.
Skill cost = skill threshold minus attack threshold. EX cost = EX minus attack; boss cost = boss minus attack. EX/boss restore barrier. Active opponent boss causes boss-tier fallback to EX.

Reimu skill initializer uses three script20 VMs, fixed release center, 45-frame attack plus 60-frame tail; radius 0->64->0 over two 22-frame interpolations, phase advances 10 degrees/frame, grants 40 invulnerability frames. The file is pl00.anm (player +44); hidden initial collider radius is 64 (XMM3 loaded from 005aa368). Before time45: three cancellation circles radius64, damage4/life1 every5 ticks. Tail: one growing cancellation circle 128+(t-45)*64/60 with integer division; damage1/life24/radius64/growth1 collider each frame.
Character vtable at 005a8a18: +0xc basic, +0x10 skill, +0x14 EX, +0x18 boss, +0x24 opponent boss-active query. EX/Boss callbacks spawn ExtraAttack/BossAttack on opponent field, default HP 200.

FUN004ee770 cancels live/appearing non-invulnerable bullets using radius plus half sprite width. FUN005200f0 collider arguments were checked in disassembly, including hidden XMM3 radius. Ghost cancellation through FUN00530c60 remains unported.

ECL 512 registers/unregisters boss slots; 513 resets phase time; 514 installs HP/time interrupt; 515 sets damage invulnerability. 1034/1035 select incoming EX/boss rank. Original pl00.ecl/default.ecl control entry, firing and defeat. Host byte dispatch table is 0x505560+(opcode-300), target table 0x50524c.

Skill phase uses a local xorshift RNG; boss move opcode412 uses an approximate bounded random target. Global -9888 = clamp(opponent status+0x44, 0, status+0x40)/200 (getter 004fc530 case 0xffffd960); FUN_00549830 adds 1 to +0x44 per death, but the setter of the cap +0x40 was not found, so -9888 stays 0. Do not claim exact attack trajectories until resolved.

Byte dispatch table 0x505434+opcode (FUN_004fecc0). Implemented: 520 = wait while a boss slot of this field is occupied (FUN_0040b4b0 x3, handler returns -1 -> Flow::Retry); 525 = FUN_0050ca70 destroy enemies without flags 0x20/0x80/0x400 (0x100 overrides) through the death path with drops cleared. Identified but not ported: 516 sound, 517 screen shake (FUN_004b9f00), 522 spell declare (XOR-obfuscated name; FUN_004f67c0; HP tracked x7), 523 spell end (FUN_004f6730), 559 damage multiplier +0x5164 (unused by Reimu scripts), 1036 player death via FUN_00549830 (Boss00 only calls it when -9886 is set). Still unsupported: 521,524,527,534,621,624,1020. ANM transforms319/329/330 are implemented from FUN004fe350.

EX/boss levels are status +0x38/+0x3c (0..7). The release controller dispatches, then raises the sender's level by one (EX inline, boss via FUN_0040b3a0), capped at 7; the gauge HUD (FUN_004e8a20) prints level+1. The attack plays at the level shown before release: HUD Lv N = script rank N-1. Evidence: Touhou Wiki's Reimu tables (EX Lv1 1 wave of 6, Lv2 1 of 8, ... Lv8 4 of 8; boss Lv1-2 nonspell, Lv3-4 'Wildly-Fired Yin-Yang Orbs', Lv5-8 nonspell + 'Rampaging Yin-Yang Orbs') match ExtraAttack's ins_570 tables [6,8,...]/[1,1,2,2,3,3,4,4] and Boss00Boss's rank masks only at rank = pre-raise level. Unresolved: 1034/1035 (FUN_0040b620/0040b660, ECX = opponent status) return the stored value and creation does not run the script, so the code path that yields the pre-raise value was not found. A death raises each level by one while below 3 (FUN_00549830).
Godmode (viewer key G) is a development toggle, not an original-game feature: Player::hit ignores hits for both sides while enabled.

-9887 = EnemyManager+0x40 and -9886 = +0x44 (004fc530/004fd720 read *(ctx+0x68e0)->+8). Only FUN_0050d740 writes +0x40 (forced boss phase) and only FUN_0050e740/FUN_0050d6f0 write +0x44=1 (scripted senders called from 004f77a0/004f7b90/004f7e80); the plain VS boss send FUN_0050d800 writes neither, so both read 0 in VS.

Reimu boss by rank (pl00.ecl Boss00Boss with -9887=0; HP from BossStartInit args 5000,1500,5000+1500): ranks 0-1 Boss00Boss1 non-spell, 5000 HP, 1800-frame limit; ranks 2-3 Boss00BossCard1 spell card, 1500 HP, limit -9923*60 = 1800; ranks 4-7 Boss00Boss1_H non-spell, 6500 HP, at 1500 HP or 1800 frames -> Boss00BossCard1H spell (1800 frames). Every phase ends in BossDead. Rank-masked op 570 values make later ranks denser. With HUD Lv N = rank N-1: Lv1-2 non-spell, Lv3-4 spell card, Lv5-8 non-spell + spell (switch at 1500 HP).

Dev keys (viewer, game mode): 1-4 fill player 1's gauge to that tier's threshold so the normal release fires next frame (state checks and boss->EX fallback kept); C removes all bullets, enemies, bosses and attack scripts on both fields without death effects. Development aids, not game features.

Boss entrance: Boss00 clears the field (525, 616 radius 640); BossStartInit keeps the boss hidden 91 frames while EffChargePoint2 x2 sets enemy ANM slots 8-11 to effect.anm 147/148/152/151 rotated pi/2, 5pi/6, pi/2, pi/6 (ECL 319). Each is ANM effectNew(1) (FUN_004bd660 op508 -> FUN_00506940 table 0x5ca6d0 entry 1): a timer spawns one group per frame while <50 (scripts 143 x3 subtract-blend with the parent colour, 144 add-blend with colour bytes 0x2c-c, I0 copied); each child follows Hermite curves (FUN_00407ba0, mode 8) from 300 out (+-150) to 150 out (+-50) then to the centre (+-20), I0=60 frames each; the effect deletes itself when no child remains; interrupt 1 skips the timer by 300. Not ported: ECL 621 RenderMeshInf (radius 160, likely the boss distortion field), 522 spell-card presentation.

ANM variable writes only resolve listed ids: ints 10000-10003, 10008, 10009, 10029 (FUN_004c1400); floats 10004-10007, 10013-10015, 10023-10025, 10027, 10028, 10033-10035 (FUN_004c14c0). Other ids return the instruction's own argument, so the write is lost (e.g. effect.anm 147's fset to 10000 leaves I0=60).

Spell cards: ECL 522 (case 0x43) declares via FUN_004f67c0 and sets +0x5020|=1, +0x5014 = HP*7; FUN_00509980 then subtracts damage from +0x5014 and sets HP = +0x5014/7 (+0x5018 base is never set), so cards take 1/7 damage (Reimu's 1500 HP cards absorb 10500). 511 also resets the x7 counter (FUN_0040f840). The declaration spawns the boss file's script 0 (enemy manager +0x4adc = ECL ANM slot 3, pl00b.anm; slots load from +0x4ad8 in FUN_0050b940): eff04 scaled to cover the field fading in over 60 frames plus rotating eff04b at alpha 192, layer 4. 523 (FUN_004f6730) ends the card. Not ported from the declaration: name banner (text file script 0, [0x62c484] script side+2), effect.anm scripts 6 and 13, interrupt 2/3 to FrontInf per-field VMs (+0x54/+0x58 of 0x6c blocks; creator not found), card bonus.
Dev keys: Shift+1-4 make player 2 release that tier (EX/boss land on player 1); --boss-level N sets player 1's starting boss level for screenshots. Development aids.

Bomb (spirit strike): button bit 4 (`+0x2a8 & 4`) in the player state machine FUN_00546320 starts it in state 1 (normal) and in state 4 (the 8-frame hit window: bomb pressed there restores state 1 = deathbomb) when FUN_004ed6d0 allows it (bomb stock status+0x68 in 1..10, no bomb running (+0x18 != 1), FrontInf +0x310 == 0). FUN_004ed7d0 builds the character's BombInf object from the table at 0x5a02d0 (Reimu = BombReimuInf, vtable 0x5a8b50: +4 init 0053c7d0, +8 update 0053c510, +0x10 end 0053c480), stores the meter (status+0x24, 0..2500) and spends one stock. Reimu: duration FUN_004ed3d0(120,250) = max(120, 250*meter/2500) (x status+0x90/100, default assumed 100); radius interpolation 1 -> meter*224/4000+128 (268 at 2500) and y scale 1 -> meter*32/4000+16 (36), both mode 4 (decelerating), over the duration; pl00.anm (player+0x44) script 19 (flash) and 16 (ring, scale (radius, y scale)) at the player. Every frame before the end: player protection block (+0x2074..) set to 0x28 (40), player cancel circle FUN_004ee770(radius, max 99999) (invulnerable bullets survive), laser cancel FUN_00530c60 (lasers not ported), a collider FUN_005200f0 (radius = interpolated, lifetime 1, damage 10, flag 0x10) hitting every enemy inside each frame; at the duration the VMs get interrupt 1 and the screen shakes (FUN_004b9f00 6,6; not ported), the bomb ends 10 frames later and the meter restores from status+0x28. Practice implementation (user-authorised): C = bomb, meter taken as full, no stock used, edge-triggered. Visuals rendered but not compared with the original; the y squash does not show because the Poly primitive ignores scale y (unverified).

Skill/damage colliders created each frame or with lifetime (Reimu's skill tail: lifetime 24, growth 1) were limited to one hit per enemy; like all colliders they hit every overlapping enemy every frame (FUN_0051fa30 clears the last-hit id). The per-enemy 90 cap per frame still applies.

Spell card name (ECL 522, case 0x43 of FUN_004fecc0): args id, time, bonus, then a length-prefixed string whose bytes are XORed with a key starting at 0x77 whose step starts at 7 and grows by 0x10 per byte (Shift-JIS once decoded; pl00.ecl gives 霊符「乱撃陰陽玉」 / 霊符「蹂躙陰陽玉」). FUN_004f67c0 spawns ascii.anm script 0 (the name bar, sprite 285, anchored right) and text.anm (DAT_0062c484) script side+2 (sprite 13/14, a 640x40 rectangle of the run-time '@' surface) at (164|476, 16), and FUN_004cd480 draws the name into that rectangle with font slot 0: Meiryo 48 px when the system has it (FUN_004b3630 probes 'メイリオ'), else MS Gothic 32 px (FUN_004b2f40), white over a black outline drawn at the eight neighbouring offsets from (x+2, 2), Meiryo read from row 6 (FUN_004b2a50). The scripts start large in the middle (scale 4 -> 0.5/0.75), then from 60 frames slide to the top-right corner (296, 32) in mode 2. FUN_004f6e90 from 120 frames fades them (interrupt 3) while the player is above y 96 and restores them (2) below y 128; FUN_004f6730 (523) sends interrupt 1. APPROX: the original starts the text at x = rect width - 16 * bytes (laid out for the 32 px font); the port right-aligns by the measured Meiryo width.

ECL 517 (only in default.ecl BossDead: [30, 12, 0]) creates screen effect type 1 (FUN_004b9d40 -> FUN_004ba250): for 30 frames each axis moves by -s, 0 or +s at random (rand % 3; the x case 2 writes +s to the viewport arrays despite storing -s in DAT_0062c414) with s going 12 -> 0, applied to viewport index 2 (+0x44). Not ported: which drawing viewport index 2 offsets was not established. The VS boss timer (FrontInf +0x58/+0x5c, ascii.anm scripts 2/3, FUN_00512b60) only runs after ECL 1018, which no VS script uses.

findings.text: Do not conflate chain timer FUN00549780 with charge meter. Enemy death calls FUN0051d4e0, which invokes several distinct reward helpers. Prior investigation has not identified natural charge-meter gain.

Player shots register colliders (FUN_0051f320: size record+0xc along the shot angle, record+0x10 across, damage, hit interval 1, group 0). FUN_00509980 tests them against the enemy hurtbox from op 500 as a circle of radius w/2 (rectangle when flag 0x1000) via FUN_0051e670/FUN_004d44e0, skips an enemy that collider already hit within the same frame (the last-hit id +0xa8 is cleared every frame by FUN_0051fa30, so piercing colliders re-hit every frame), caps a frame's total at player+0x2274 = SHT+0x28 (Reimu 90), multiplies by player+0x2270 (1.0 in VS) and divides by 5 while the shooter's state is 0 or 2. Not ported: the 1.5x bonus within 48 px when status+0xb4>0, the /5 rule, the per-frame cap, and the /30 rule for spell flags 0x21 (not set by 522).

Draw order: the ANM manager (FUN_004d0da0) registers one draw callback per 2D layer at draw-chain priorities L0..L36 = 5,7,9,10,11,13,16,18,20,21,22,24,27,28,33,34,37,40,43,46,49,50,58,60,62,63,70,66,67,71,74,76,79,81,96,98,101 and L43..L51 = 61,72,75,77,78,80,97,99,102 (37-42 not found). The bullet manager (FUN_004f6470) draws enemy bullets itself at 0x29 (41), between layers 17 and 18. Previously bullets used their script layer (0) and were hidden under the layer-4 spell background, so spell cards looked like they fired nothing; the visible green clusters were spawn effects.

2026-10-02: local player shot and skill collider damage now accumulated per enemy per tick and capped at SHT+28 (Reimu90), then divided by5 in Entering/Dead states before subtracting normal HP or raw spell counter. Original00520450 cap and00509980 state division verified; simultaneous120damage regression yields90normal or90raw spell damage, entering yields18. Chain explosions still processed separately; ability damage multipliers/48pxbonus/special spellflags remain incomplete.

Bullet cancel eligibility by mechanism (all from the executable): (1) kill explosion FUN_0051c8c0: bullet state==1 (live) only, type (+0x1078) < 4, centre distance <= (radius+1), NO invulnerability or sprite-width test (invulnerable small bullets are cancelled; types>=4, spawning and already-cancelled bullets are not). (2) ECL 613 FUN_004edf90: every bullet of 2000 whose state is not 0 or 3, invulnerability irrelevant. (3) ECL 615/616 FUN_004ee880: state 1 or 2, circle test FUN_004ee950 with radius + sprite width/2 (+0x674), invulnerability NOT checked; counts +1 at manager+0x815708. (4) Player/skill cancels FUN_004ee770: state 1 or 2 AND bullet+0x14 (invulnerability) == 0, radius + sprite half width, at most param_4 bullets. Each cancel runs FUN_004eeb30: plays bullet.anm cancel script chosen by FUN_004f11a0 from the type's cancel_mode (0: colour*2+6; 1: table 0x598c20 {6,10,14,18,22,26,30,36}; 2 none; 3: 0x12; 4: 8; 5: 0xe; 6: colours[c][3], i.e. 164/212 for small bullets), sound 0x47, sets state 4, and FUN_004ee9b0 item drops (types 9/2 via FUN_00521c60 counters; items/meter not ported).

Explosion-cancelled bullets are converted into attacks (FUN_0051c8c0 -> FUN_0051c650/FUN_0051c250 -> FUN_0051bd50): per cancelled bullet the chain hit count rises by one with no chain time (FUN_00549780(0)); a flying copy (sprite scale 0.8) leaves the explosion for the opponent's field along a Hermite curve (tangents x+-100,y-400 and x+-100,y+100), 60..159 frames, to a point x within 16 of the bullet and y in 0..32; on arrival it fires one bullet there: speed rand*0.2 + min(bullet speed+0.5, 6) + pressure/200*2, angle pi/2 +-30 degrees from the middle (|x|<64) or an inward quarter turn from the sides (APPROX: FUN_00404c90's result is hidden). The carried type is the bullet's own while the round counter (GhostCtrl+0x28) is below 3600; then 90% (3600..7199), 80% (..10799), 70% (later) keep it and the rest become type 4. Score/meter calls FUN_00548bc0/FUN_00548d00/FUN_00548c60 and the C3/C4 counters (status2 +0x20/+0x24 gain 1 per cancelled bullet at chain>9) are not ported.

Slow-mode hit marker: FUN_00546ed0 spawns effect.anm script 19 (0x13) at the player while focus is held (scale 1.0), following the player each frame, and sends interrupt 1 on release. Script 19 spawns child script 18; the sprites are effect.anm sprite 23 (64x64 spiked ring with the white/red centre dot) and sprite 24 (green glow). Ported by running those scripts (user screenshot Screenshot 2026-10-03 112457.png as the visual reference); the earlier drawn red disc was a guess and was removed.

Combo counter (FUN_00546080): player +0x22b4 is the chain, +0x227c the chain timer, +0x22b8 the number shown. When the chain is >= 2, beats the shown number and the timer is running, the shown number becomes the chain and a display timer (+0x2290) restarts at 120. Correction (2026-10-03): FUN_005450e0 decrements the display timer at combo+0x18 and clears combo+0x40 when it reaches zero (assembly 00545120-005451a6). It also decrements combo+4 and clears the reward chain at combo+0x44 on expiry. The previous never-cleared conclusion was incorrect because it inspected drawing without the timer update. The port now counts display time down and retains the native blinking tail: reward-chain expiry clears gameplay hits, while the latched HUD count flashes yellow/gray in three-frame phases until display time expires. This supersedes the immediate-hide interpretation after the user clarified that flashing must match the original. bot.summary: Player 2 can be driven by the game's computer player (CPUInf / CPUHitReimuInf) at Normal difficulty, or just hold the shot button (K toggles).

findings.text: Structure: CPUInf (FUN_004fb6f0) makes a CPUHitReimuInf / CPUHitMarisaInf object (vtable 0x5a8430 / 0x5a8444: +0 pick target, +4 brain FUN_004fa3e0, +8 approach rule). Dodging: FUN_004f8f60 builds an 18-bit danger mask for the 9 directions x (normal, focused) speeds (from the sht), positions clamped to x +-140, y 32..432; a candidate is dangerous when its distance squared to a circular hazard is below radius^2 + margin^2, with margin 10x, 5x then 1x the hit radius (3) while every candidate is hit. All 18 hit at the smallest margin: the bot presses bomb only. If the chosen candidate is hit, with probability level% (10 at Normal, +1 per 600 frames after frame 0x708, to 100) it ignores it; otherwise the first free alternative from the 16-entry table at 0x598f70 is taken and held 8 frames. FUN_004f9530 picks the hazard heading at the player (distance^2 - radius^2*speed < 128^2, within 30 degrees of its heading and the straight path passing within radius+16, or nearer than 32 and ahead); the bot flees perpendicular to the bullet's heading, bent away from walls, quantised to 8 directions; a bullet not heading at it makes the bot stand still. Walls: x < -136 / > 136 push inward, y > 400 pushes up, held 4 frames.

Reimu targeting: FUN_004f8930 picks the nearest enemy not hidden/invincible/unhurtable that is within 48 px and at least 16 above, or within |x| < 100 and 32 below..256 above (spirits within 64 px horizontally count a third of their distance; disabled spirits and ones on the 10-frame reversal cooldown are skipped; a second pass ignores those rules). FUN_004f8c50 / FUN_004f8dd0 move to within 12 px horizontally (8 for spirits) and 160 (80 for spirits when below y 128) to 256 px below the target, and focus within 64 px horizontally. Meeting a spirit also holds charge for 20 frames (15 while dodging), at most 50 times. Shot is held whenever any enemy qualifies. With no target the bot returns to x +-80, y 320..416. Charging: with meter >= a tier and the gauge below it, hold charge towards skill (mode 2), EX (3) or boss (4, always checked), re-rolling the mode.

Not ported: laser hazards (no lasers yet), rectangular enemy hit boxes, the item-chasing branch (no items yet), story-mode CPU helpers (CPUStageNStoryInf, which also release charge), the other characters' targeting rules (CPUHitMarisaInf etc.), and difficulty (Normal assumed; Easy starts at 40%, Hard and Lunatic at 0%, ramp every 240 / 600 / 1200 / never). Orb sources: (1) graze: FUN_004f5130 / FUN_00549e00 return a graze when a live bullet is outside the hit circle (3 + bullet radius) but inside radius (3 + max(40, r/2.5)) with the same bullet radius term; FUN_00549fb0 adds 1 to the graze count (status +0x80) and calls FUN_00521c60 at the bullet's position. Each bullet is grazed once (its graze timer only advances at graze events; assumed). (2) Enemy death (FUN_0050c1f0): after the chain is extended (FUN_00549780) an enemy with an item type drops it, and for a chain above 5 min(3, chain/12 + 1) orbs drop. (3) Enemy bodies with public flag 0x200 that are inside the graze ring and not touching the player throw an orb at the player every 6th frame of their own time (FUN_00509980). FUN_00521c60 accumulates the drop rate (+0xff8e8, 100 default) and throws one orb per 100 in a +-10 degree fan around up at speed 2.

Attacks a side sends (ExtraAttack, BossAttack, special bullets) run the SENDER's program and sprite slots on the receiver's field (enemies carry an owner side). Stage waves and spirits live in default.ecl / waveNN.ecl, included by every character's program. Character select: Reimu 1, Marisa 2.

Marisa's SHT: same speeds (5/2) and radii as Reimu (hit 2.3), main shots are kind 7 needles (48x18, damage 16 / 9), options are kind 2 beams (callbacks [2,2,0,2], record interval 15, one live per SHT group, phase staggers the side beams), slot 10 is one charge beam and slot 11 the two side charge beams at +-32 (callbacks [12,9,0,8]); slots 20..37 are shared with Reimu. Callback tables: init 0x5a0440, update 0x5a0400, +0x4c 0x5a03fc, hit 0x5a03d0 (indexed by the record's four ids).

Option beam (FUN_0054d9e0 init, 0054d370 update, 0054cd70 hit): a rotated rectangle collider of width = record hitbox y (16) that starts at the option (or player) plus the record offset, points along the record angle, grows 18 px per frame while its length is <= 512 (stops at 522), and ends when the shot button is released, the player is hit or dead, charging starts (gauge >= 1) or a bomb runs. Each overlapping enemy is damaged on every 4th frame of the beam's age by the record damage; the beam is cut to the entry distance of the (last) overlapped enemy plus 8 (ray vs circle of radius half width + hurtbox radius, FUN_004d3720). An even-frame impact glow (record +0x2e, pl01.anm script 10) appears at the end; the VM gets interrupt 2 while hitting and 3 afterwards, scale2.x = length / 512 (the sprite is 510 px long), rotation = angle. All colliders' damage to one enemy is capped per frame by SHT+0x28 (90).

Charge beam (callbacks 12 / 9 / 8, FUN_0054ccf0 / 0054c830 / 0054c7c0): the same geometry, but it lasts until its age passes 0x77 frames regardless of the shot button, is not cut by what it hits, and damages every overlapping enemy on every frame (the hit callback returns the record damage each frame). Fired from the release controller: slot 10 once on any release (FUN_0053cbe0 calls FUN_0054f990(0,0,10)), slot 11 additionally after the skill start (FUN_00417b90 sets +0xd4 = 1).

Marisa's charging aura (AuraMarisaInf, FUN_00417840 / 00417980 / 00417a10 / 00417a60) is a column, not a circle: pl01.anm script 15 with scale x = half width, grown 1 -> 14 over 20 frames (mode 4) at 100% rate (Reimu: circle 1 -> 64). Bullets are slowed when |x - centre| < width; for bodies the game tests an oriented rectangle (centre x, y 224, width 2w, height 448) with FUN_004d2c30; the port tests the body's x extent against the band.

Marisa's skill and special bullet are laser orbs, not local effects: FUN_00417b90 (skill) makes six EXLaserInf objects (vtable 0x5a8b8c; init FUN_0053d280, update FUN_0053d150) from her position to the opponent player's x on y = 448 along Hermite curves whose two tangents are 600 long, rotated a sixth of a turn apart starting at straight up; FUN_0053cf00 (special bullet; thresholds 0x59d7d8 = 100/90/90/80 like Reimu's) makes one with random tangents like Reimu's yin-yang (x within +-120). The orb flies bullet.anm script 63 (sprite 326, scale 0.8) for 60..159 frames and on arrival requests ExtraAttack00 (hp 200) on the other field, run from the sender's program (pl01.ecl: an infinite laser). EXOnmyoInf (Reimu) is the same object with the bullet-type-44 sprite.

Marisa's bomb (BombMarisaInf, FUN_0053dc50 start / FUN_0053d9b0 update): pl01.anm script 23 (flash) and 18 (column, scale x = half width) at her position; the half width interpolates (mode 4) from 1 to meter * 64 / 4000 + 16 over max(180, 350 * meter / 2500) frames (FUN_004ed3d0(0xb4, 0x15e)); each frame it holds her protected 40 frames, cancels bullets in the band centred on her x (y 224, full height; FUN_004ee0d0, live or appearing, not flagged) and lasers (FUN_005303f0, not ported) and damages enemies in it for 20 (FUN_0051f320(.., life 1, 0x14)); 10 frames after the duration it ends.

Marisa's bot rules (CPUHitMarisaInf, vtable 0x5a8444): FUN_004f9810 picks targets like Reimu's but without the third-distance bonus for spirits within 64 px; FUN_004f8d10 uses x tolerance 12, minimum distance 160 and maximum 256 below the target, and for a spirit when she is below y 128 stays 16..40 px beneath it (Reimu 8 px / 80..256).

Continuation of 7090364 and Claude's uncommitted laser changes: ECL 702 constructs a line laser; 703 constructs an infinite laser. ECL 700 supplies current/cap lengths, travel limit and width, plus the ET direction/speed/origin/distance. Line lasers grow then travel (0052e0c0), shrink at their travel limit, and receive a 30-frame off-field grace period (0052fca0). Their hitbox uses 80% of length with width rules in 0052db90. ECL 569 handler at 00504f38 calls 004d3140 against x +/-148, y 0..448 and selects the forward intersection using a direction-angle comparison. Only this callback-clear case is supported; nonzero IDs remain reported.

Native laser cancellation samples at distances 8,24,40,... and cuts at 16-pixel boundaries. Infinite circle/all cancellation uses the strict end test; rectangle and line area cancellation include the exact end. The rectangle overlap receives projected step components (16*cos(angle),16*sin(angle)); checked assembly 0052d4b0..0052d4f8. Circle checks sample centers. Invulnerability (+85c) is tested only when the caller requests it. ECL 613 visits both bullet and laser managers; 615/616 do so within a circle. Player circles/Marisa bomb columns now also visit lasers.

0052d680 trims the line tail, retains the first survivor and spawns surviving runs longer than 24 pixels as separate line lasers. 0052ac90 keeps the infinite emitter-side prefix (which can grow again), converts downstream surviving runs into travelling lines at speed 8 and limits travel by original cap minus segment offset. All-cancel sets the laser dead. Cancel animations are chosen by original type/color; extended Ex state is not yet copied to fragments because laser Ex programs are unported. Developer clear also removes every laser and its VM.

ECL711 case0x98 from opcode table505560 creates LaserCurveInf(type2). Init copies ET time1 as node count (Sanae normal32); curve Ex ANGLE_ACCEL a=duration,b=absolute start,r=speed acceleration,s=angular increment. Nodes are analytical path samples(age-i); discrete whole-tick integration then fractional remainder. Finite accel appends linear segment. Native sprite callback3 returns color+524 (not bullet sprite remap); triangle strip width/2 normals averaged across adjacent nodes; body gradient longitudinal UV. Player contact builds node rectangles after accumulating16, lengths speed*1.1, width*.5*(type2?.55:1.1); original initial heading contributes center offset. Player cancels respect INVULN300; script cancel can bypass. Runs<=3 nodes discarded when split. Endpoint effect sprites and non-angle-accel curve Ex remain unported.

CPU constructor004fb6f0 chooses Marisa hit controller only for character1; all others including Sanae/Ran use Reimu controller. Existing bot laser avoidance remains unported, so shared AI limitation applies here.

Ran scope ANM11 spawns four script12 arms after setting parent variable10004 to 0,pi,-pi/2,pi/2. Native child constructor004d0770 executes the child immediately, so509 copies spawn-time variables. ANM318 maps to native case11/flag40000 and scales child position by root parent scale in00404050. Primitive603/606 dispatch to rotated gradient-rectangle renderer004c4d20 independently of sprite render_mode. Regression renders native scope extents +/-105 on both axes at scale30; same script-child behavior applies to Ran bomb13.

Option update 00546d10 per option: target (+0x70/+0x74) = player pos + offset table row chosen by player+0x2070 (focus) unless option flag bit2 is set, in which case the per-option callback (+0x11c) owns the target. Current eases by player+0x2114 percent (always 30) of the remaining distance each tick; a hold counter (+0x100) snaps to target while it counts down. 005483d0 rebuilds ALL options only when the option count changes, starting each at player+offset (not at the player), and installs by character id: 3 (Ran) -> 0054a120 with hold 10, 6 -> 00545b70, 0xd -> 0054a190, 0x11 -> 0054a260.

Ran option latch 0054a120 (character 3): while unfocused (player+0x2070==0) it stores the player position in player+0x6a0/+0x6a4 every tick; the option target is its own offset (unfocused or focused row) + that stored position. Held focus therefore leaves the orbs at absolute positions where the last unfocused tick put them, with focused offsets; releasing resumes following and the normal 30%-per-tick ease returns them. Shift before moving or while moving is the same rule. Shots read option+0x78/+0x7c (current position) via 0054f990/0054e960 (player+0x5d8+n*0x128+0x78), so origins follow the held orbs. Player init zeroes +0x6a0 only; the Rust anchor starts at the spawn position (initial +0x6a4 not proven).

Graze award 00549fb0: graze count +0x80 (cap 99999999), queue pool type 4 on the bullet manager with delay rand&7 and the effect position/colour, throw orbs via 00521c60, sound 0x2a with pan x*1000/192 (sound not implemented: no audio). Pool tick 00505cf0 counts the delay down then 00506940 spawns effect.anm script 0 with callbacks: init 004dc010 (random heading in [-pi,pi], 20 colours with alpha 0xff for the first ten then ~(k*0x18)), per-tick 004dc250 (fade existing points by 0x10, append one point 1..9 px away along the heading, heading += random in [-pi,pi]; ends when 20 points exist) and draw 004dc440 -> 004c3f40 (D3D line strip, 1px, normal alpha blend). Colour is bullet+0x694 (type colour table [c][4] for cancel-mode-6 types, else 0xffd08080) and 0xffd08080 for lasers (+0x860).

Bullet graze gate (004f5130): a bullet grazes when in the ring with allowance (+0x1018, always 1 because manager flag +0x815718 is only ever zeroed) and timer +0xfd8 on a multiple of 120 (starts at 0, so the first contact grazes immediately); in range the timer ticks and the out-of-range timer resets; after 60 out-of-range ticks the allowance and timer reset. Laser effects appear at the closest point (004d3580) of the hit segment to the player; the straight-laser segment arguments are assumed equal to its contact rect (hidden-register call), curved lasers use the player position.

Contact presentation in 004f5130 (label 004f54a7) is entered when a bullet is in the player graze ring (00549e00 returned 2) or in the scope (local_14 != 0): interrupt 2 at contact age <2, tint ARGB ff/ff/clamp((0x68-age)*2,0x60,0xff)/0x80, and a shake +0x48/+0x4c set from two game-RNG draws, each uniform in [-1,1) pixels (00404bd0 with multiplier 1.0), zero when not in contact. Only the scope slows movement. So a grazed bullet takes the same tint as a scoped one; the shake consumer for bullets was not located (enemies add +0x48/+0x4c to their draw position in 004feb00), so it is applied to the bullet sprite position.

005483d0 gives every option a second ANM VM (SHT header +0x40; Ran pl03 script 9, a rotating clock hand fading in) while power clamped to 0..400 reaches 400, deletes them below it, and 00546d10 positions both VMs on the option each tick. Normal play is power 200, so only Ran C2 boost (600 ticks) shows it.

Focus (player+0x2070 from input bit 8 in 00546ed0) changes: movement speed rows, shot slot +5 (0054f990), option offset rows (00546d10/004dea70), the focus shadow VM (script 0x13), the player-shot flag bit 2 (no consumer found for playable characters), Ran option latch 0054a120, character-6 callback radius 40->24 (00545b70, not playable), and the 0054e490 aim sway update which only runs unfocused (consumer 0054c430 is not referenced by any playable SHT). FUN_0050c1f0 skips one block under that flag: kill credit FUN_0051d4e0 (types 0/1/3/4) AND the chain update FUN_00549780 (chain count +1, chain timer). Death effect, explosion and orb throwing stay. SUPERSEDED (first reading mapped ids through the 0x5c4e00 rows by row index, which was wrong): Sound effects: FUN_004bb8d0(id, pan) queues a request (up to 12 distinct ids per frame, up to 60 pans each); pan is DirectSound hundredths of dB, callers use x*1000/192. CORRECTED sound mapping (the id=file-index reading above is also wrong, found by ear: enemy hit played nep00). The init after the wav load loop (decompile line ~163814) gives sound id N the DirectSound buffer file index row.field1 of the FIRST row of the 0x14-byte table at 0x5c4e00 whose first dword equals N (rows are not in id order). The spell object +0x7c gets bits 0x203 and loses 0x98 on declaration (004f67c0) and loses bit 1 on spell end (004f6730), so bit 1 = spell active. 0x23 (damage01) plays for a boss below 900 (200 while a spell is active); APPROX: bit 8 of the spell object (with bit 1 it suppresses 0x23) has no setter found and is treated as clear. Charge gauge (AuraCtrl, aura.anm = AuraCtrl+0x10): FUN_004e9740 spawns script 0 at (164|476, 456) with children 1-12, runs FUN_004e8a20 once and interrupt 4 at once. FUN_004e8a20 every frame: children are found by script number (FUN_004caed0 -> FUN_004cb0a0, depth first); marker pairs 5/6, 7/8, 9/10, 11/12 at x = threshold*224/2500 - 112 for attack/skill/EX/boss, state 1 (above meter: interrupt 5 via FUN_0040b7e0), 2 (reachable: 3), 3 (charged past: 2), sent only on change; meter bar (script 3) and charge bar (script 4) scale x = value/2500; while charging a cursor (script 13) sits at the charge bar's position + charge*224/2500, 4 screen px lower; labels (text style 0, centred, top-aligned, layer 0) 'Ex.Attack Lv%d' 0xffffff80 / 'Skill' 0xff80d0ff / 'Boss Lv%d' 0xffff8080 at (centre + marker x, 448) for the reached tier, and grey (0xffc0c0c0) 'Lv%d' (boss / EX level + 1) at y 461 under the markers not yet reached; while a bomb runs a cursor (script 15) marks the meter; with handicap bits 0x38 set the meter bar flashes (interrupt 2 via FUN_0040b840) once the meter reaches the EX threshold and resets (3) otherwise.

findings.text: Orin's focus scope and bomb box were invisible: pl07.anm scripts 13/14 use ANM623 and 15/16 ANM626/627, which the VM ignored. ANM dispatch (FUN_004bd660, ops 301..: byte table 0x4c1268[op-0x12d] -> 0x4c10c4): 623 sets draw type 0x25 (+0x74 f0, +0x78 f1, +0x470 f2 corner radius, +0x460 segments); 624 0x26; 625/626/627 0x27/0x28/0x29 with +0x474 thickness. FUN_004c50f0 computes A = scale.x chain * +0x74 and B = scale.y chain * +0x78 (x R for res modes 1/5, R/2 for 2/6): type 0x25 draws FUN_004c2cc0, a fan from colour 1 at the centre to colour 2 at n+1 points on a corner circle of radius c (unscaled), offset by +-(A-2c)/2, +-(B-2c)/2 by quarter (index < n/4 or == n top-left, then top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left), angles from -pi; 0x27/0x28/0x29 draw FUN_004c2460, a band of thickness t centred on c, c + t/2 or c - t/2 (colour 1 inner, 2 outer).

Nazrin's pyramids (ExAttack, flag 0x10 invincible, ECL 547 hurt sound 36) were silent because the port skipped the damaged flag for invincible enemies. FUN_00509980 adds every hit to +0x501c and sets +0x5170 |= 0x20 (flash and damage sound) whether or not flag 0x10 / +0x512c apply; only HP is skipped.

Screen shake = ScreenInf type 1 (FUN_004b9f00(type=ECX, duration=EDX, start, end, .., 0x67, index) -> FUN_004b9d40 -> FUN_004ba250): per frame timer+1, stop at duration; s = start + (end-start) * t / duration; each axis rand%3 -> 0, +s, -s, except the x case 2 writes +s to the field cameras (DAT_0062c414 gets -s). It writes slot `index` (+0x14c + 8i) of the three field cameras (0x62be14 + k*0x18c, scaled by R) and always DAT_0062c414/418; the task 0x532090 (draw priority 0x68) zeroes them each frame. Field layers pick slot = side (FUN_004cc030 / FUN_00405690), so slot 2 is never read by a field; the stage camera copies DAT_0062c414 (FUN_004ec1e0, FUN_0040cdf0 reads +0x15c). Sprite quads add manager +0xc4/+0xc8 in pixels (FUN_004c9380), primitives do not. ECL 517 (case 0x3e): FUN_004b9f00(1, arg0, arg1, arg2, .., 2) shakes the stage only (BossDead: 30 frames 12 -> 0); every bomb update's end (time == duration) calls FUN_004b9f00(1, 15, 6, 6, .., side): its field shakes 6 px. The bomb end sounds (stop 0x31, 0x2c) also happen at time == duration, not 10 frames later.

Presentation ECL ops without VS display: 524 (case 0x45) sets the spell number (DAT_0062ba8c via FUN_0040f4d0, enemy +0x5630) used for the capture bonus; 527 (0x48) writes (threshold / max HP, value) to GameState +0x32c per spell slot (FUN_0040fb30); 534 (0x4b) writes GameState +0x2e8 (FUN_0040f4b0). No reader of +0x32c or GameState +0x2e8 was found.
